'''Robert Eugene Lanou Jr.''' (February 13, 1928 – August 17, 2026) was an American physicist.

== Early life and career ==
Lanou was born in [[Colchester, Vermont]] on February 13, 1928, the son of Robert Lanou Sr. and Flora Goyette. He attended the [[University of Vermont]], and he enlisted in the [[United States Navy]] in 1946. After his discharge, he attended [[Worcester Polytechnic Institute]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|ScB degree]] in [[physics]] in 1952. He also attended [[Yale University]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1957.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/name/robert-lanou-obituary?id=62269161|title=Robert E. Lanou Jr.|work=Legacy|access-date=September 4, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>

He served as a professor in the department of physics at [[Brown University]] from 1959 to 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://physics.brown.edu/people/robert-lanou|title=Robert Lanou|work=[[Brown University]]|access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.burlingtonfreepress.com/obituaries/pbur1554092|title=Robert Lanou, Jr.|work=[[Burlington Free Press]]|date=August 31, 2026|access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 1966, he was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=lanou&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref> and in 1968, he was named a [[Lists of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=lanou&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
In 1960, Lanou married Cornelia Wheeler. Their marriage lasted until Lanou's death in 2026.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.providencecremation.com/memorials/robert-lanou-jr/5739357/|title=Robert E. Lanou Jr.|work=Berarducci Funeral Home & Cremation Care Center|access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref>

Lanou died at the Hope Health Hospice in [[Providence, Rhode Island]], on August 17, 2026, at the age of 98.<ref name="a" />
